short_description: Access Rights Restriction
description: Merchant reported being unable to e-sign the Merchant Agreement due to an access permission error in the UI, halting the onboarding process.
resolution: Development team identified a bug in the service configuration module that was blocking the setup. A code fix was deployed, allowing Sales Agent to configure services for the additional location.

short_description: Merchant data displaying incorrectly
description: During the data upload process for a new merchant, the API endpoint consistently returns a 500 error, preventing sales agents from successfully onboarding the merchant.
resolution: Rectified the issue by performing a data refresh to fetch and display the accurate merchant information in the Sales UI.

short_description: Touchscreen malfunction on Merchant's device for e-signing
description: Merchants facing frequent network timeout errors while submitting data, leading to delays in onboarding process.
resolution: Development team identified a bug in the service configuration module that was blocking the setup. A code fix was deployed, allowing Sales Agent to configure services for the additional location.

short_description: Error in Equipment Configuration
description: Sales Agent encountered an error when trying to onboard an additional location for merchant ID 12345. The system displayed a 'Duplicate Location' error message.
resolution: Resolved by clearing the browser cache and reloading the Customer UI. PDF now loads successfully.

short_description: Equipment Configuration Freeze on Legacy Browser
description: An issue arose where fees were calculated inaccurately for a specific equipment bundle, leading to potential financial discrepancies; Sales Agent and Merchant affected.
resolution: A bug in the equipment selection module was identified and fixed by the development team. Sales Agent was instructed to reselect the equipment and verify successful saving.

short_description: Merchant unable to submit e-signed agreement
description: A Sales Agent's access to configure service fees for a merchant is restricted erroneously, preventing them from finalizing the onboarding process. Merchant onboarding delayed.
resolution: Backend developers investigated the issue and resolved the database conflict causing the duplication error. Sales Agent successfully continued with setting up the new location.

short_description: Equipment selection not saved for new location
description: During the onboarding process for an additional location, the Sales Agent received an error message stating 'Location already exists' even though it's a new location being added. This issue caused confusion and delays in completing the merchant setup.
resolution: Investigated API logs, identified a server-side issue causing data retrieval failures. Applied a patch to the API server to resolve the issue.

short_description: PDF not loading for Merchant Agreement review
description: Upon successful login, the Merchant encounters a blank screen instead of the expected Merchant Agreement review interface.
resolution: Advised Sales Agent to switch to a supported browser. Unfroze the session, verified data integrity, and recommended browser upgrade for future stability.

short_description: Error message 'Invalid Signature' when attempting to e-sign Agreement
description: Sales Agent encountered an issue where a specific POS terminal model, 'ABC-2000', could not be selected while configuring equipment for a merchant.
resolution: Reviewed and adjusted the permission settings for the Merchant UI, allowing the merchant to successfully e-sign the agreement and proceed with onboarding.

short_description: Intermittent connection issues while configuring services
description: After configuring fees and services for a new merchant location, Sales Agent noticed that the changes were not reflecting in the system. This discrepancy caused delays in finalizing the onboarding process.
resolution: The network timeout issue was addressed by optimizing network settings and increasing timeout thresholds, allowing Sales Agents to successfully complete the equipment selection process without further interruptions.

short_description: Access permission error preventing merchant fee configuration
description: Merchants are experiencing network timeouts when trying to retrieve and e-sign the Merchant Agreement PDF. This is causing delays in the onboarding process as merchants are unable to proceed.
resolution: Investigated the issue and found a misconfiguration in the equipment database linkage. Corrected the configuration, and now Sales Agents can see and select equipment options as intended.

short_description: Equipment selection not saving for new merchant location
description: Sales Agent notices that the merchant data inputted is not displaying correctly in the Sales UI, hindering the completion of the onboarding process.
resolution: Investigated and resolved the issue by fixing a backend database synchronization error that was preventing configuration saves.

description: Merchants are experiencing network timeouts when trying to retrieve and e-sign the Merchant Agreement PDF. This is causing delays in the onboarding process as merchants are unable to proceed.
resolution: Collaborated with the hardware vendor to troubleshoot the integration problem, resulting in successful configuration of the payment terminal for seamless merchant transactions.

short_description: Merchant ID not recognized for additional location

resolution: The network team identified a routing issue causing the intermittent connections and resolved it by optimizing the network configuration to ensure stable and uninterrupted service.

resolution: Reviewed and adjusted file permission settings for the Merchant Agreement PDF, granting appropriate access to merchants for e-signing. Ensured merchants could view and sign the agreement without further issues.
